drift.interpretation: Выраженное изменение распределения оценок не обнаружено.

protocol.ordering: Publication date ascending, then article id ascending; first N test articles.
protocol.probabilities: Previously saved test probabilities; no repeated inference or model fitting.
protocol.prediction_timing: Current predictions and review decisions are fixed before observing the current label.
protocol.feedback_timing: The dataset label becomes oracle feedback immediately after each prediction.
protocol.adapted_parameter: Decision threshold only; classifier coefficients remain fixed.
protocol.reference: Saved validation probabilities are used solely for score-distribution monitoring.
protocol.metric_scope: Binary metrics cover every event, including its underlying class prediction when sent for review. automatic_accuracy covers only non-review decisions.

limitations: Oracle corpus labels simulate immediate perfect feedback; this is not a live user-feedback or fact-checking evaluation.
Threshold adaptation uses earlier test labels sequentially. These are prequential metrics, not unchanged offline hold-out metrics.
The first N chronological test articles may not represent the complete test distribution.
No improvement is guaranteed, and ISOT source-confounding and language limitations remain.
Drift monitors scores, not truth or verified changes in accuracy.
